necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and recent episodes of transient cerebral ischemic attack, characterized by intermittent palpitations and brief episodes of neurological deficits. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
